author: Unity
description:
Dive into the 8-year journey of D-CELL's breakthrough title, UNBEATABLE – a rhythm-based narrative action game made with Unity, where music is illegal and you do crimes.

Hear from Andrew Tsai, cofounder and creative director at D-CELL, who discusses the unique challenges and artistic decisions behind a game that started as a high school daydream and sold over 100,000 copies at launch eight years later.

This video explores:
✅ How the team tackled the complex challenge of audio precision in rhythm games, utilizing Unity and FMOD to sync game events and audio precisely in real time.
✅ Strategies for creating a dynamic, anime-inspired look by placing 2D character sprites into 3D environments.
✅ The team effort, commitment, and passion required to ship a massive project.

🔗 Explore more Made with Unity games: https://on.unity.com/UnitySteam

title: UNBEATABLE: How D-CELL makes 2D sprites pop in 3D environments
